stories.title: Burnham to give councils more powers to block vape and betting shops
stories.summary: Andy Burnham announced plans to give local councils new powers to reject or restrict betting and vape shops taking over high streets, part of a wider crackdown on 'rip-off' business practices to ease cost of living.

stories.title: PM urged not to change scheme that could free PC Andrew Harper's killers early
stories.summary: Burnham is facing pressure not to alter an early-release scheme that could see the killers of PC Andrew Harper released, amid a wider prison overcrowding crisis; No. 10 says it is exploring every legal option to block early release.

stories.title: Labour prisons crisis dominates politics live coverage as Farage weighs in
stories.summary: Rolling coverage of the prisons crisis shows Burnham vowing a crackdown on 'rip-off' business practices while Tories claim he has 'run out of ideas'; Reform's Zia Yusuf claims sending offenders abroad would free jail space.

topics.name: Burnham Gov Intelligence
topics.description: Procurement, tech/AI, spending, vendor & priority signals

stories.title: 🤖 DSIT watchdog head grills government over departmental shake-up
stories.summary: Science and Tech Select Committee chair Chi Onwurah has called for more detail on the recent major revamp that will see DSIT scrapped and its functions (including GDS) absorbed elsewhere in Whitehall.

stories.title: 🤖 GDS's budget for FY27 boosted over 50% to £620m
stories.summary: Annual accounts for DSIT, the tech department now being scrapped, show GDS consolidated its role as the centre of digital transformation with a sharply increased FY27 budget.

stories.title: 🏗️ G-Cloud 15 aims to expand SME opportunities
stories.summary: A significant upgrade to the government's flagship cloud procurement framework aims to widen opportunities for smaller tech suppliers competing for public sector contracts.

stories.title: 🚦 DSIT's AI leader Ilott moves to Cabinet Office
stories.summary: As digital and technology teams begin moving to new departmental homes following the DSIT shake-up, one of the outgoing department's senior AI leaders is relocating to the Cabinet Office.

stories.title: 🤝 Team ORION: quiet build-up to a Future Defence Support Services bid
stories.summary: KBR, Unipart and IBM have formed 'Team ORION', widely read as positioning for the MOD's £8-18bn Future Defence Support Services (FDSS) recompete, going head-to-head with a rival Leidos/DHL alliance defending the incumbent LCST contract.

stories.title: 🤖 Government invests in data for AI jobs 'early warning capability'
stories.summary: Government is investing in data infrastructure intended to create an early-warning capability tracking AI's impact on employment across the economy.

stories.title: 💰 Post Office reveals additional £14.4m deal for Horizon replacement system
stories.summary: Following delays and extensions to a major tech contract, the Post Office has revealed a separate £14.4m engagement with a bidder that appeared to have lost the original competition, citing no third-party way to customise the platform.

topics.name: Parliament
topics.description: House of Commons, House of Lords, PMQs, legislation

stories.title: Commons in summer recess — light legislative activity
stories.summary: The House of Commons remains in its summer recess; Hansard's most recent sitting record is from 9 August. Parliament is scheduled to resume sitting on 1 September 2026.

stories.title: Andy Burnham apologises for Labour's stance on Gaza
stories.summary: In a Politics Weekly UK podcast revisit, Burnham apologised for Labour's previous position on Gaza, saying the party 'didn't get it right'.

stories.title: Burnham vows crackdown on 'rip-off' business practices
stories.summary: As part of a wider cost-of-living push, Burnham announced measures targeting 'rip-off' business practices, drawing criticism from the Conservatives that the government has 'run out of ideas'.

stories.title: Tories attack Burnham over 'lack of ideas' on cost of living
stories.summary: Conservatives under Kemi Badenoch criticised Burnham's cost-of-living crackdown announcements, claiming the government has run out of ideas.

stories.title: Former neo-Nazi activist offered adviser role by Kemi Badenoch
stories.summary: Joshua Bonehill-Paine, a former neo-Nazi activist who withdrew as a Tory local council candidate, has reportedly been offered an advisory role by Badenoch, prompting fresh controversy for the party.

topics.name: Reform UK
topics.description: Nigel Farage, party news and announcements

stories.title: Farage demands sacking of Rupert Lowe aide as price of uniting British right
stories.summary: Nigel Farage has ruled out cooperation with Rupert Lowe's Restore Britain unless an aide is sacked, dealing a blow to hopes of uniting factions on the British right.

stories.title: Reform UK: send foreign prisoners abroad to end early releases
stories.summary: Reform UK's Zia Yusuf claims sending foreign offenders abroad would free up jail space in the UK, wading into the prisons overcrowding row.

stories.title: Ann Widdecombe: police investigate whether accused had role in Farage incident
stories.summary: Police are investigating whether a person accused in a separate matter had any involvement in an incident concerning Nigel Farage.

stories.title: SNP lacks 'vision' under Swinney and needs 'sea change' — former MP Cherry
stories.summary: Former SNP MP Joanna Cherry has said the party lacks vision under John Swinney and needs a fundamental 'sea change' to succeed.

stories.title: Why Andy Burnham's economic agenda presents a problem for the SNP
stories.summary: Analysis suggests that while Burnham has ruled out another independence referendum, his economic agenda could pose a more fundamental challenge to Swinney and the SNP than constitutional questions.

stories.title: Former SNP MP Joanna Cherry says she is 'not obsessed' with Nicola Sturgeon
stories.summary: Cherry has hit back at Sturgeon after the former First Minister suggested she was preoccupied with her, saying she is open about disagreements but not obsessed.

topics.name: Cabinet Office
topics.description: Government reshuffles, senior appointments, cross-department policy

stories.title: DSIT's AI leader Ilott moves to Cabinet Office
stories.summary: As the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology is dismantled and its teams redistributed, one of its senior AI leaders, Ollie Ilott, is moving to the Cabinet Office.

stories.title: Lord Ashcroft poll: voters split on which party will win the next election
stories.summary: A new Lord Ashcroft poll suggests uncertainty among voters over who they expect to win the next general election, referenced amid ongoing UK politics live coverage.

stories.title: Wait continues for Greater Manchester mayoral by-election result
stories.summary: Coverage notes the ongoing wait for a result in the Greater Manchester mayoral by-election, triggered following Burnham's move to No. 10.

stories.title: House of Lords: business quiet during summer recess
stories.summary: UK Parliament's business listings show a quiet period for the House of Lords during summer recess, with sittings not resuming until 1 September 2026.
